en: A black-and-white image of a European street, lined with two- and three-story buildings featuring tiled roofs and dormer windows. Businesses and residential facades are visible, with German signage on several buildings. A child stands near a door on the left, and further down the street, a horse-drawn carriage can be seen approaching a prominent building with an ornate clock tower and spire. The setting feels historical, likely early 20th century or late 19th.
